data.title: 不知火舞 · 道场晨训的扇舞
data.description: 清晨道场，不知火舞穿着系好的红色训练上衣与白色长裤，完成一遍受控扇舞后利落合扇。高马尾随着收势轻摆，脚步站稳，画面没有对手或火焰。

data.promptProse: Mai Shiranui completes a controlled fan-dance sequence in the empty dojo and closes the sensu as her feet settle into a balanced stance. Her securely wrapped red jacket, broad belt and white training trousers remain neat, brown high ponytail following the last movement. The medium portrait includes the plain wooden floor and practice wall. Morning light illuminates fan ribs and focused eyes, with a grounded stance shadow stretching over the floorboards.
